236:t_1:9.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...Anger, hatred, sorrow... everything is melting together... like clear water...」

236:t_1:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「...So this is... what $$アクエリオン$$ means...」

236:t_1:15.en:
$$アムロ$$
「No...! $$ララァ$$'s soul isn't in a place like this...!」

236:t_1:17.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$カミーユ$$... And everyone else, too...」

236:t_1:19.en:
$$刹那$$
「I don't know... We were caught up in a $$時空震動$$...」

236:t_1:20.en:
$$シン$$
「But no ships, no machines, and us here in the flesh like this...」

236:t_1:22.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's like when $$ニュータイプ$$s resonate with each other, but...」

236:t_1:23.en:
$$刹那$$
「Yes... It's also similar to a space filled with GN particles...」

236:t_1:24.en:
$$ガロード$$
「If so, why am I here instead of $$ティファ$$...!?」

236:t_1:25.en:
$$ロラン$$
「If you're going to say that, then me too...」

236:t_1:26.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What do the people here have in common...?」

236:t_1:30.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We gained... civilization... And then we gained tools... $$ガンダム$$...」

236:t_1:31.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ガンダム$$ was... born in war and burned the world, and through it all we... keep moving forward, committing countless sins...」

236:t_1:32.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Get a grip, Captain $$アムロ$$!」

236:t_1:33.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Is Captain $$アムロ$$ the only one who senses something...?」

236:t_1:34.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wrapping the world in flames, humanity... evolves... That is... the civilization... of fire...」

236:t_1:36.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Is that the same thing the $$プロトカルチャー$$ said in the ruins!?」

236:t_1:37.en:
$$ロラン$$
「$$ガンダム$$ is... the civilization of fire...」

236:t_1:38.en:
$$アムロ$$
「And that leads on to the sun's radiance, and humanity goes beyond evolution, to $$シンカ$$...」

236:t_1:43.en:
$n
「No! I... I don't want to die!!」

237:t_000:1.en:
$$メラン$$
「It seems we have been thrown by a $$時空震動$$ again.」

237:t_000:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The navigation system's position sensor is still pointing to the galactic center!」

237:t_000:4.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「I confirmed every ship is safe! But $$バトル７$$ is unconfirmed, and I can't get through to them on comms!」

237:t_000:5.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All $c units are aboard their ships.」

237:t_000:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「So everyone who was there was thrown together...」

237:t_000:7.en:
$$オットー$$
「B-but the center of the galaxy, while certainly far from Earth, was still the universe we know!」

237:t_000:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「But this is clearly different...! What on earth is this place...!?」

237:t_000:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「...A world we don't know... Is this some other parallel world...?」

237:t_000:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Did you figure something out, $$ミレイナ$$?」

237:t_000:14.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Oh... um... I just thought... it's beautiful, that's all.」

237:t_000:15.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「...True. It's definitely an unknown world, but even I can't help staring.」

237:t_000:17.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...I've spent a fair amount of time in space and seen all kinds of stars and nebulae, and I feel the same.」

237:t_000:18.en:
$$ボビー$$
「If it weren't for this situation, we could enjoy it more freely...」

237:t_000:19.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$フェルト$$... Has the position sensor stopped working?」

237:t_000:22.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Our current coordinates are the center of the galaxy... and they point to the exact center.」

237:t_000:23.en:
$$メラン$$
「So it's different from the region of space around the planet $$ネオ・ラクス$$ where we were?」

237:t_000:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Have we merely been thrown to the center of the galaxy we came from?」

237:t_000:26.en:
$$オットー$$
「What is it, Captain $$ジェフリー$$?」

237:t_000:27.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Even comparing against the galactic star chart, it's certain that this is a place different from the universe we know...」

237:t_000:28.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「But we can't say for sure that this isn't the center point of the galaxy.」

237:t_000:30.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「We don't fully understand what state the center point of the galaxy is in.」

237:t_000:32.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Even before that, distortion of the dimensional boundary makes observation barely possible...」

237:t_000:33.en:
$$オットー$$
「Isn't that only true of the world Captain $$ジェフリー$$ and the others come from?」

237:t_000:34.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「No... I've heard that sort of thing too.」

237:t_000:35.en:
$$メラン$$
「So have I. And it's not just in the $$ＵＣＷ$$, but also in the $$宇宙世紀$$ world I come from.」

237:t_000:36.en:
$$ブライト$$
「So in every parallel world we know of, the center point of the galaxy is shrouded in mystery?」

237:t_000:37.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「...Significant proposal. Regarding that, the $$人類銀河同盟$$ holds certain information.」

237:t_000:38.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Ensign $$レド$$. I'd like to ask you to disclose that information. Would that be all right?」

237:t_000:39.en:
$$レド$$
「No problem. ...$$チェインバー#pilot$$, permission granted.」
